title: IT Infrastructure
description: Mockup of 25 virtual machines as a status wall (green, yellow, red, hover explains why), with recommended maintenance tasks and a demo flow from detection to a verified fix.
insights: Fictional VMs and measurements, no live monitoring. The colour is calculated from fixed rules: CPU, memory, disk, backup age (production), missing security patches and TLS certificate expiry.
Hover over a VM, or focus it with the keyboard, to see which check made it green, yellow or red, the limits, and the recommended task.

Every reason becomes a task (renew certificate, install patch, free up disk space, catch up backup, check an unreachable VM) that runs through detect, propose, approve, run, verify. The run is simulated; the plan comes from the n8n workflow 05-vm-maintenance-plan through the chat tool run_vm_maintenance_plan.
'Start demo' walks through six steps. Nothing is restarted or changed; a person approves.
prompt: Bundled example: IT Infrastructure (static, data embedded by npm run sync:it-infrastructure).
